formal_statement: have x1 : (Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool := fun (x1 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => x1 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (2 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (2 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (4 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (5 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (2 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (6 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (7 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (4 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (6 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (5 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (7 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x1 (7 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x1 (4 : Fin (8 : ℕ)); have x2 : (Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool := fun (x2 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => x1 x2 || x2 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x2 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ)); ∀ (x3 x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x5 : ℕ) (x6 : Bool),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x3 →     PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x4 →       x3.size + x4.size ≤ (13 : ℕ) →         x5 < (8 : ℕ) + x3.size →           have x11 : (Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) → List Bool := fun (x11 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => x3.wires (List.ofFn x11);           have x12 : (Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool := fun (x12 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => (x11 x12).getD x5 Bool.false;           (∀ (x13 : Fin (8 : ℕ)), (x12 ≠ fun (x14 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => x14 x13) ∧ x12 ≠ fun (x14 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => !x14 x13) → (∀ (x14 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool), x1 x14 ≠ x2 x14 → x12 x14 = !x6) → (∀ (x15 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool), x4.eval (x11 x15 ++ [x12 x15]) = x1 x15) → ∃ (x16 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool), x4.eval (x11 x16 ++ [x6]) ≠ x2 x16
plain_statement: Let g be the edge function of the 8-vertex graph left when vertex 4 is removed from the Petersen graph minus a vertex, and g' = g OR x_0 OR x_3. For circuits A on the eight inputs and B on A's wires plus one extra wire, at most 13 gates together, a wire h of A that is no input and no negated input, and a constant b with h different from b wherever g and g' differ: if B computes g when the extra wire carries h, then B fails somewhere to compute g' when it carries b.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate NOT x_4 computes its edge function
